ui_scope: Adds an always-on temporary dotted Moon orbital arc to the known-good Earth view; no controls or layout changed.
orbit_distance: visually scaled inward; not to scale
title: EARTH // LIVE — Moon Orbit Preview v1.39
description: Adds a temporary dotted 10-day Moon orbital path automatically on the existing Earth view, with a brighter dot marking the current-time sample. Uses the existing local Moon calculation and keeps the path visible without any clicks. Orbit distance is visually scaled for readability; the lunar model is approximate. Existing Earth UI and controls are preserved. Requires iPhone/PWA testing.
